services.name: Space Rental
services.desc: Host your next party, reception, special event, meeting, or seminar at one of Diversity Richmond’s spaces. Diversity Richmond has a number of event spaces for rent to match almost any occasion. Whether you are celebrating a quinceanera, holding a fundraising event for your organization, throwing a dance party or hosting a corporate networking or training event, we've got a space for you! Our facility is centrally located between Hermitage and Brook roads, with ample free parking and easy access from I-95 and I-64. We offer flexible set-up times, event support staff, A/V equipment, and day and nighttime availability. Non-profit organizations are eligible for a reduced rental rates.
